title: Fix a buggy pagination helper
task:
Users report that `paginate()` in `src/paginate.js` returns the wrong items and wrong page counts. Fix it.

Required behavior:

- `page` is 1-based: page 1 is the first page.
- `totalPages` is `Math.ceil(totalItems / perPage)`, so an empty list has 0 pages.
- A page past the last page returns an empty `items` array (not an error).
- `hasPrev` is true only when `page > 1`. `hasNext` is true only when `page < totalPages`.
- `page` and `perPage` must be integers >= 1, otherwise throw a `RangeError`.
- Do not mutate the input array.

Keep the function name, export and return shape the same. Run the tests with `npm test`.
